THE GOOD:
• Instantaneous startup time and file opening even on massive log/code files
• GPU accelerated rendering engine for butter-smooth scrolling
scenes.voiceover_script: First, the strengths. Sublime Text 4 excels at instantaneous startup time and file opening even on massive log/code files and offers gpu accelerated rendering engine for butter-smooth scrolling.

THE BAD & PRICING:
• License fee required for continuous nag-free usage
• Model: Paid (Unlimited Evaluation)
scenes.voiceover_script: On the flip side, keep in mind that license fee required for continuous nag-free usage. As for pricing, it's structured as $99 per license for 3 years of updates; full feature evaluation with occasional pop-up..
